ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Osia HyperRetail Limited has formally entered the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), with its Resolution Professional having published Form G to invite Expressions of Interest (EOIs) from prospective resolution applicants. This signals severe financial distress, highlighted by a drastic reduction in employees from 1,236 to just 48, indicating significant operational impairment and extremely high risk for investors.
